answer: Imagine a lighthouse whose beacon sweeps one harbor each epoch, and every ship must catch the beam through its own narrow inlet — a memory-hard channel that admits one attestation per epoch and only from the ship that tended it. The nectar of reward flows only through inlets tended ten seasons: one honest ship, ten seasons, weight 100. Ten clones behind one purse share a single inlet, so each catches a tenth of the beam and weighs 1 — ten against 100, yet each still pays a full bond. One ship, one inlet, one beam.
